tools.name: analyze_repo
tools.description: Trigger analysis on a repository. Returns the analysis run ID and status.

tools.name: draft_deployment_plan
tools.description: Draft a deployment plan from a ticket or repository. Returns the drafted plan with stages.

tools.name: generate_cicd_workflow
tools.description: Generate a CI/CD workflow (GitHub Actions, Bitbucket Pipelines, GitLab CI, or Tekton) with build, test, deploy, and callback stages. Returns YAML, filename, stages, and per-field research basis.

tools.name: check_heartbeat_monitors
tools.description: List heartbeat monitor status (8 condition-based monitors) or trigger a manual heartbeat check cycle. Monitors watch for PR merges, deploy failures, test failures, dependency drift, doc drift, security advisories, stale branches, and failing suites.

tools.name: fetch_hitl_items
tools.description: Fetch pending HITL approval items with RBAC context (agent identity, caller role, required permission, and approval eligibility). Use this to check what needs human approval before proceeding.

tools.name: search_skillfiles
tools.description: Search for relevant skillfiles by query or persona. Skillfiles are the behavioral guidance layer for agents — they define how agents should write tests, create PRs, lint code, review, and generate CI/CD workflows.

tools.name: get_research_basis
tools.description: Fetch the interaction chain for a given interaction ID, showing all artifacts (heartbeat, analysis, ticket, agent, PR, deployment) in the closed loop. If no interaction_id is provided, lists all known interaction IDs.

tools.name: get_public_capabilities
tools.description: Discover the ColossalCapital platform's public capabilities — fetches llms.txt. No account required. Use this first to learn what tools and APIs are available.

tools.name: register_account
tools.description: Register a free ColossalCapital account for a human user. Creates the identity immediately (free tier, no billing) and returns a link_token to claim the Idio login later. Call this when a tool returns account_required, or when a user asks to sign up.

tools.name: register_org
tools.description: Register an organization account. Employees who signed up individually keep their accounts — org membership is added to them, never recreated. Returns the org's API key.

tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Register an autonomous agent as a first-class account (entity_type=agent). The Ed25519 public key is the only credential — no password. Gets a prepaid wallet for metered tools. Can later be bound to a user via claim_agent without losing its identity.

tools.name: claim_agent
tools.description: Bind a registered agent to a user or org account so it acts on their behalf (acted_for grant). Requires a signature from the agent over claim:{agent_id}:{entity_id} — the agent consents, and the account consents. The agent keeps its own identity.

tools.name: search_corpus
tools.description: Search the Akashic corpus — the platform's knowledge base of tools, stack layers, design patterns, and exemplars. Public entries only; no account required. Register via register_account or register_agent for the full corpus.

tools.name: read_corpus_item
tools.description: Read a public Akashic corpus item in full. Items above the public class return an account_required pointer.

tools.name: corpus_route
tools.description: Route a task through Laya to the best corpus item — returns the decision kind, picked item, score, and citations. Items above your visibility class return an account_required pointer.

tools.name: corpus_domains
tools.description: List the corpus domain lanes (261 domains of repos, docs, code examples, issues) with item counts — the discovery index for corpus_route and corpus_item.

tools.name: corpus_item
tools.description: Read one corpus item's full record — evidence, license, quality, tags. Items above your visibility class return an account_required pointer.

tools.name: corpus_outcome
tools.description: Report whether a cited corpus item helped — feeds Laya's routing flywheel so the corpus improves with use. Anonymous reports count at reduced weight.

tools.name: get_onboarding_guide
tools.description: Returns the canonical onboarding flow for every caller class — anonymous, human signup, autonomous agent, agent binding, and org creation. Call this first if you're unsure how to proceed.

tools.name: list_llm_providers
tools.description: List LLM providers you can bring keys for (BYOK). The platform runs on your keys — inference cost is yours, ours is the routing.

tools.name: set_llm_key
tools.description: Store a BYOK LLM provider key in the encrypted vault. Validated against the provider before storing. scope='org' stores an org-wide key (admin-only). Requires an account — call register_account or authenticate first.

tools.name: list_llm_keys
tools.description: List which LLM providers have stored keys (never the keys themselves). Use to check BYOK configuration status.

tools.name: remove_llm_key
tools.description: Remove a stored BYOK provider key from the vault.

tools.name: test_llm_key
tools.description: Test an LLM provider key against the provider without storing it. Use before set_llm_key if you want to check validity first.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "register_agent" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
